documents.title: Announcement Under Regulation 30 (LODR) - Communication To Shareholders.
Announcement Under Regulation 30 Of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 - Communication To Shareholders
Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Second Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026.

analysis.summary: Management reported a significantly higher profit for Q1 FY27, noting it as the second highest in the company's history after Q1 2022, driven primarily by better realizations despite a war-like situation and lower sales volumes. Several plants that were previously non-operational due to cost economics resumed operations in July, and the company is progressing with ongoing capital expenditure projects including a Dahej steam and power project. Management highlighted positive developments such as revised energy norms for urea and ongoing cost-saving initiatives supported by consultants like A.T. Kearney. Management reported financial and operational results for Q1 FY 26-27, noting that operating revenue marginally increased quarter-on-quarter due to improved realisations, while profit before tax decreased due to lower volume, higher input costs, and fixed costs.

guidance.claim: Management expects TGU production to be more or less at the same level as that of the last financial year.
guidance.quote: See, basically it is our expectation of the TGU production to more less at the same level as that of last FY.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that there is a shortage of TDI in the Indian market that will definitely affect pricing.
demand_outlook.quote: Yes, there is a shortage in the Indian market of TDI that will definitely affect the pricing.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for ammonium nitrate is projected to grow at a CAGR of 6% to 7%.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the ammonium nitrate is concerned, CAGR is around 6% to 7%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management does not expect any issue in absorbing additional ammonium nitrate volumes due to the CAGR and government thrust.
demand_outlook.quote: So going forward, as Mr. Tejash told, looking to CAGR and ambitious thrust by Government of India for self-sustenance on coal route, we do not expect any issue in absorbing the additional volume produced by us.

capex_expansion.claim: Total projects on hand amount to INR2,800 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total projects on hand are of INR2,800 crores, okay?

capex_expansion.claim: Capex incurred in Q1 was INR300 crores in CWIP.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex incurred was INR300 crores in CWIP.

capex_expansion.claim: Projects under consideration include BisPhenol-A at Dahej, Polyols at Dahej, and Acetic Acid at Bharuch.
capex_expansion.quote: UNDER CONSIDERATION : 1. BisPhenol-A (BPA) – Dahej 150 KTPA 2. Polyols – Dahej 100 KTPA 3. Acetic Acid - Bharuch 350 KTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The dialogue regarding licensing for additional capacity with INEOS is ongoing.
capex_expansion.quote: For the capex, there is an update which we have covered in the investor presentation that we had earlier plan of JV with INEOS. Now we are talking to them about licensing for additional capacity. So that dialogue is on with INEOS.

capex_expansion.claim: New projects identification will have clarity by the end of the calendar year.
capex_expansion.quote: The new projects identification will have clarity by end of this calendar year for taking it to the investment table-grade decisions.

capex_expansion.claim: The total capital expenditure for FY27 is expected to be around INR 2,800 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The capex for FY27 is going to be around INR 2,800 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Ammonium nitrate, weak nitric acid, and ammonia expansion projects are on track with a minor delay of about 2.5 months in weak nitric acid.
capex_expansion.quote: See, both these 3 projects actually, ammonium nitrate, weak nitric acid and ammonia expansion are going on track. There is a slight minor delay in case of weak nitric acid of around 2.5 months.

margins_costs.claim: Input costs have gone up because of the war situation.
margins_costs.quote: Similarly, the input costs have also gone up because of the war situation.

margins_costs.claim: Energy norms for urea have been revised upward from 6.20 Gcal to 6.37 Gcal per metric ton.
margins_costs.quote: It was 6.20 Gcal per metric ton of urea, which is revised to 6.37 Gcal now.

margins_costs.claim: Q-o-Q revenue increased mainly due to improved realisation, partially offset by lower volume, while results decreased due to higher input cost and fixed cost.
margins_costs.quote: During Q-o-Q Q 1, Revenue marginally increased mainly due to improved realisation across all of the products, which is partially offset by lower volume in majority of products. Result is decreased mainly due to higher input cost and fixed cost partially offset by better realization.

margins_costs.claim: The Coal Based Steam & Power Plant is expected to improve the operating margins of TDI II.
margins_costs.quote: • Coal Based Steam & Power Plant: Expected to improve the operating margins of TDI II.

margins_costs.claim: Except formic acid, all other chemicals experienced a positive realization on a sequential quarter basis ranging from 6% to 28%.
margins_costs.quote: Product to product, but if you see the range, it is from 6% to 28%.

margins_costs.claim: Losses are widening in the fertilizer segment as revisions in urea fixed cost and energy norms are yet to happen.
margins_costs.quote: In case of fertilizer, the revision both in urea of fixed cost as well as energy norms are yet to happen. And this is overdue as the losses are widening in case of Fertilizer segment.

margins_costs.claim: The net reduction in oil prices on a sequential quarter basis was INR 3,000 per metric ton.
margins_costs.quote: There is a net reduction of INR 3,000 on a sequential quarter basis on a per metric ton sequential quarter basis.

orders_capacity.claim: Ammonia production in Q1 was approximately 173,000 tonnes, with 54% from oil and 49% from gas.
orders_capacity.quote: Ammonia production was approximately 173,000 and 54% out of that was from oil and 49% was from gas.

orders_capacity.claim: Total TDI production was 12,800 tonnes, with 66% from the Dahej unit and 34% from the Bharuch unit.
orders_capacity.quote: So TDI total production was 12,800 a breakup of 66% from Dahej unit and 34% from Bharuch unit.

orders_capacity.claim: Total WNA production was 113,000 tonnes with a 70% and 30% split between two plants.
orders_capacity.quote: WNA total is 113,000 production with a share of 2 plant, 70% and 30%.

orders_capacity.claim: Except for ANP, acetic acid, ethyl acetate, and TDI which were shut during part of the quarter, all other plants operated beyond rated capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: I will say that except ANP, acetic and Ethyl and TDI which were shut during part of the quarter. Rest all the plants have operated beyond the rated capacity, whether it is ammonia, urea, both with nitric acid.

orders_capacity.claim: Plant capacity utilization for acetic acid and most other plants is above 100%, while TDI is close to 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: See, plants are running at a peak capacity. Capacity utilization in case of acetic and most of the plants is above 100%. So far as TDI is concerned, it is close to 80%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company produced more than 210,000 tons of technical grade urea in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: We produced more than 210,000 in FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board declared a dividend of 210% amounting to INR 21 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Considering all this, Board has in general declared a dividend of 210%. This is INR21 per share, which is historically the second highest dividend in its history of 50 years.

risks_headwinds.claim: The war situation caused escalation and deescalation, leading to viability issues and fluctuating realizations and input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Overall, during the quarter 1, it has been the situation of escalation and deescalation as far as war is concerned. And that has a ripple effect on the business as well, in terms of, at times, viability issues, at times, realizations, which have gone up. Similarly, the input costs have also gone up because of the war situation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Certain plants like acetic acid, ethyl acetate, and TDI could not be run during the quarter for cost economics reasons.
risks_headwinds.quote: During this quarter gone by, there are plants which we could not run for cost economics reason, like acetic acid, ethyl acetate and to some extent, TDI as well.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gas prices remain volatile and volume availability is a concern, though company operations have not been affected.
risks_headwinds.quote: Similarly, on front of the gas, the prices remains volatile and availability of the volume is always a concern, but our operations are not affected with -- on account of availability of the gas.

risks_headwinds.claim: The continuing war has changed the equation of value addition with an adverse divergence between feed cost and final output realisation in some cases.
risks_headwinds.quote: The continuing war has change the equation of value addition as in some cases, there is adverse divergence between feed cost and final output realisation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Methanol production was impacted because cost economics did not work out given very high gas prices and high oil prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Whereas in case of methanol, the cost economics did not work out given the very high gas price. Even the oil prices have been hovering high, so we could not use even our oil-based methanol plant.

risks_headwinds.claim: Acetic acid production volume was capped due to internal calculated issues.
risks_headwinds.quote: One is acetic acid and second is methanol. There is -- in case of acetic acid, we had certain internal calculated issues because of which the volume was capped -- production volume was capped, which did not result into the sales volume, therefore.

risks_headwinds.claim: Aniline face competitive headwinds and heavy dumping from China.
risks_headwinds.quote: In spite of the competitive headwinds, which were particularly noticed in case of aniline TDI, the company not only survived but did better during the year.

management_commitments.claim: The revised energy norm for urea is valid for a 3-year period starting from FY25-26.
management_commitments.quote: This has been revised for a period from FY25-26, and valid for 3 years period.

management_commitments.claim: Power from the Dahej project is expected to come in a month's time or around 45 days.
management_commitments.quote: And power, we are expecting to come in a month's time or so or around 45 days' time.

management_commitments.claim: Quantification of savings from Kearney is expected to have a better picture flowing into P&L by next quarter end.
management_commitments.quote: And maybe by next quarter end, we may have a better picture flowing into P&L.

management_commitments.claim: Except for CCPP, the rest of the projects under execution are going to be commercially operational sometime in the mid of 2027.
management_commitments.quote: The rest are going to be commercially operational sometime in the mid of 2027.

management_commitments.claim: The positive financial impact of approximately 61 crores for Apr-25 to Jun-26 from the New Energy Norm of Neem Coated Urea will be accounted for in Q-2-FY-26-27 after detailed examination.
management_commitments.quote: As per preliminary assessment, there will be positive financial impact of approximately ₹ 61 crores for Apr-25 to Jun-26 which will be accounted for in Q-2-FY-26-27 after detailed examination.

management_commitments.claim: The synchronization of the coal-based CCPP is revised for the third week of June.
management_commitments.quote: The coal-based CCPP, as we call it in our presentation was to start sometime in April, but the lump sum turnkey contractor faced certain delays and they have revised the date now for synchronization sometime in the third week of June.

management_commitments.claim: Performance guarantee test run for the coal-based CCPP to make it available on a full steam basis is scheduled for the third week of August 2026.
management_commitments.quote: And for the performance guarantee test run to make it available on a full steam basis, it is sometime in the third week of August '26.

management_commitments.claim: Savings from the coal-based CCPP are expected to start accruing from H2 of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: And this should start accruing to us from H2 of FY27, right? D.V. Parikh: Yes.

management_commitments.claim: The company has a planned plant shutdown scheduled in April 2027.
management_commitments.quote: We have a planned shutdown in April '27.

management_commitments.claim: Ammonia expansion, weak nitric acid, and ammonium nitrate melt projects are planned to come up by next year.
management_commitments.quote: All the three-ammonia expansion, the nitric acid, ammonium nitrate melt, all are going to come up by next year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
